_note: The canonical NooPunk core contract, on the Without Number chassis. Author direction 2026-10-26: 'For beginning, use CWN/SWN/AWN/WWN system for everything. Make the stats, skills, all rules based on them. We will modify later.' This file is the machine-readable source of truth for the WN-based core; src/rules/core.json remains the legacy 1d10 contract until its migration lands.
_source_of_truth: data/rules/wn_core.json is authoritative for the WN-based core. Implemented by src/rules/wn_core.py. Decisions: issue #615 (rules foundation policy), #564 (conversion epic).

system_identity.status: adopted for everything at the beginning; NooPunk-specific modification follows later

stats._note: The Without Number six. NooPunk's FIT/REF/INT/SOC/CYB/PSY names are retired as the core stat set; any survival of SOC/CYB/PSY is a later modification, not a second stat block.

generation.method: roll 3d6 six times in order, or assign the array
generation._note: One rolled attribute may be changed to 14. Assigning the array does not grant the free 14.

skills._note: Level 0 is ordinary competence. Unattrained is not a level: the attempt is either at -1 or blocked where training is required.

saves._note: Physical uses the better of STR/CON; Evasion the better of INT/DEX; Mental the better of WIS/CHA; Luck is flat 15.

combat._note: Attack total is base attack bonus + weapon skill + relevant attribute modifier. A character with no combat skill takes -2.

resolution_rules.determinism: every roll takes an injected RNG; explicit dice values are accepted so tests and replays are exact
resolution_rules.opposed: both sides roll 2d6 as skill checks; higher total wins, ties favour the defender unless a rule says otherwise
